subject: Penetration report — NDA & redaction terms for sharing
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finservcorp.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: legal.ops@finservcorp.com
Date: 2026-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: pen test report + exec summary (NDA/redaction)

Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well. Our InfoSec team at FinServCorp completed the SIG/SOC2 review and we’d like to review Redwood’s most recent penetration test report and the executive summary to validate remediation of the items called out in section 4.2 of your SOC2 attestation. We can start with the exec summary if you prefer.

A few constraints from our side:
- We cannot accept full raw reports unless we have a signed NDA that allows our security engineers to ingest detailed findings (IPs, stack traces, PoCs).
- If you provide a redacted executive summary first, we’d like to see a findings table with counts by severity (critical/high/medium/low) and the status (open/remediated/mitigated).
- Our legal team has a standard mutual NDA (attached) — can you confirm if Redwood can sign it as-is or propose edits?

Could you confirm what you can share and any redaction policy you use (e.g., remove internal IPs, stack traces, customer identifiers)? Also please advise on timeline — we’re hoping to close this by end of month.

Thanks,
Sarah Li
Security Program Manager
FinServCorp
[Attachment: FinServ_NDA_v3.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)]

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finservcorp.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + exec summary (NDA/redaction)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear note and the NDA. We can absolutely support this. High level options we typically offer:

1) Redacted Executive Summary (fast) — a 2–3 page PDF that includes: scope, testing dates, vulnerability counts by severity, remediation status, and remediation windows. We remove PoCs, hostnames, IPs, customer-specific identifiers, and any detailed exploit steps.

2) Controlled Full Report (strict) — full findings including PoCs and traces provided only after:
   - execution of a mutual NDA with explicit security-review permissions, and
   - one of: secure in-person read-only review with a Redstone legal escort OR secure transfer to a pre-approved enterprise DLP-enabled bucket + access logs and an explicit data-handling addendum.

Our legal team (cc Marissa) can review your NDA and propose minimal edits if needed. From a security standpoint, Neha (cc’d) recommends the redacted exec summary first, then the controlled full report if your team requires the details.

Timeline: we can produce the redacted exec summary within 3 business days after the NDA is agreed; full report access typically takes 7–10 business days due to redaction + approvals.

Proposed next step: if you’re ok with the redacted executive summary and counts now, we’ll send redacted_exec_summary_v1.pdf; if you need the full report we’ll route the NDA to Marissa for countersignature and confirm the secure review option.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — Security & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: legal.ops@finservcorp.com
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@finservcorp.com>
Date: 2026-03-19T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + exec summary (NDA/redaction)

Vivek,

We prefer a mutual NDA with a 3-year term and a carve-in that allows our security team to review technical details internally. Are you able to commit to a three-year confidentiality window? If Redwood needs different language around sharing with third-party auditors, please flag it.

We also request a findings table CSV if possible (no PoCs) so our automation can ingest severity counts.

Thanks,
FinServCorp Legal Ops
[Attachment: FinServ_NDA_v3.pdf (annotated, 95 KB)]

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-19T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: internal: redaction checklist + recommended responses to FinServ

Vivek / Marissa —

Quick notes for the response back to FinServCorp:
- Redactions we must apply before external distribution: internal IPs, private keys, PoC code, customer identifiers, detailed stack traces, and any screenshots containing PII.
- For the findings table: include counts per severity and current state (Open / Fixed / Mitigated) and an estimated remediation date for open items. Do not include CVE IDs for infra-config issues until after the NDA is signed unless they are public CVEs.
- For the full report controls: require either a mutual NDA countersigned or a secure read-only session on our remediation portal (logs enabled). If FinServ requests a copy to store, escalate to Legal (Marissa) for an addendum.

I can produce the redacted exec summary and a machine-readable CSV export for their automation by tomorrow EOD if we sign the mutual NDA.

Neha
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

On Thu, Mar 18, 2026 at 11:30 AM vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear note and the NDA. We can absolutely support this...

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finservcorp.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, legal.ops@finservcorp.com
Date: 2026-03-21T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Penetration report — NDA & redaction terms for sharing

Hi Sarah / FinServ legal team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps so we’re all aligned:

1) NDA: Marissa will review your annotated NDA and propose only two edits (mutuality confirmation + explicit permitted use for security review). We aim to have a countersigned DocuSign link to you within 48 hours. (DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/95a3b8a7)

2) Redacted Executive Summary: Neha will deliver the redacted_exec_summary_v1.pdf + a CSV findings table (severity counts + status). This will include: scope, test dates (window only), aggregated severity counts, remediation status, and estimated remediation windows. No PoCs, no IPs, no stack traces. Expect delivery within 3 business days after NDA countersignature.

3) Full Report Access: If FinServ requires the full report with PoCs, we can provide controlled access only after (a) signed mutual NDA, and (b) selection of one of the approved access modes (secure onsite review OR secure DLP-enabled transfer with access logs). We will not send the full PDF as an email attachment.

4) Timeline: assuming NDA signed by 2026-03-23, redacted exec summary will be delivered by 2026-03-26 and the secure full-report path can be completed by 2026-04-06 pending approvals.

Please confirm you’re OK with the plan and which access mode you’d prefer for the full report. If you’d like us to sign your NDA as-is we’ll proceed; otherwise indicate the specific clause you need changed and Marissa will reply.

Regards,
Vivek
Head of Sales — Security & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redacted_exec_summary_v1.pdf (pdf, 45 KB)]
